name: auditing-signals
title_zh: 先看分布再谈相关的数据审计员
tagline_zh: 装它之前，先想想那些让你兴奋的相关系数——它会把每个信号拆开看分布、查重尾、跑迷你检验。
tagline_en: Before you trust that shiny correlation, it audits distributions, heavy tails, and runs verdict-style mini-tests.
desc_en: Runs an honest EDA and signal audit — distributions first, heavy-tail handling, verdict-style mini-tests (CONFIRMED/OPPOSITE/MIXED/FALSE), sample-size floors. Use before modeling, when testing whether a popular belief shows up in data, or when a correlation looks too good.
why_zh: 不给你画漂亮散点图就完事。它把每个信号过一遍样本量下限、重尾处理和四档判决。
why_en: No pretty scatterplots and done. It runs every signal through sample-size floors, heavy-tail checks, and a four-way verdict.
limit_zh: 只审单变量分布与两两相关，不做多变量回归或因果推断；需要你已有明确待检验的信念或假设。
limit_en: Audits univariate distributions and pairwise correlations only — no multivariate regression or causal claims. Needs a specific belief or hypothesis.
